title: Update Budget
description: Updates an existing budget for a Cloud Billing account.

objective.narrative: This function demonstrates how to modify an existing budget's display name and potentially add a new threshold rule. It first retrieves the budget, modifies the desired fields, and then sends an update request with a field mask to ensure only specified fields are changed.
